brief.claim: A five-gene response signature tracks drug sensitivity across the cell-line panel: the Pearson correlation between the signature score (mean of the signature genes, which are columns 5 to 9 of expr counting from 1) and the measured sensitivity is at least 0.5.

data_keys.meaning: log expression of 20 genes per cell line, genes in the panel's list order (the five signature genes are columns 5 to 9, counting from 1); rows are cell lines
measured drug sensitivity (higher = more sensitive) per cell line, rows in the panel's order
